answer: Certified estate agent sales record with estate agents endorsement is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. A farm running 704 aliases would need 704 separate proofs, each costing about 98 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the spiral here is verification, the wander of cost is what stops the farm, and the yarrow of the record keeps every claim checkable. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
